title: Record tool refuses a review record whose rounds restart at 1
why: A lane on #3060 got past the round-3 and net-value ask: after a PASS fix verifier, it posted a fresh round 1 record (haiku) at the new head, and merge --review-record accepted it. Harm stopped: a guard change merging without its net-value review.
note: Fix: merge --review-record refuses a record whose rounds restart at 1 when an earlier record on the same PR already holds rounds or a Fix check. Only exception: a new branch with a new PR. Kind: check change, normal queue. Related: review-record-before-any-push, record-replacement-pr-rounds, decision pr-review-record.
